# Minor-bug bundle: NO_SYNC inversion, verify_completion graph=False, test-fake signature

## What
Three small verified bugs:
1. `config.py:876-877` `REBAR_NO_SYNC` inverts the truthy convention (`false`/`no`/`off` disable sync). Align with `_as_bool`.
2. MCP/CLI `verify_completion` collapses `graph=False`->None (`mcp_server.py:703`, `_cli/_llm_commands.py:275`), so own-criteria verification of an epic is inexpressible. Thread a real tri-state.
3. Workflow test fake for `verify_signature` (`tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_verification_workflow.py:98-100`) lacks `kind=`, so every call raises TypeError swallowed into `uncertified` — the certified-child branch is untestable. Fix the fake signature.

## Resolution (verified on origin/main @839477cd72)
1. `REBAR_NO_SYNC` now parses via `_as_bool` truthy convention in `_config_sources.py:319-322` (alias map :297). `tests/unit/test_config_sync_aliases.py` — 6 pass.
2. `graph` is a true `bool|None` tri-state threaded unchanged through CLI (`_cli/_llm_commands.py` `--graph` BooleanOptionalAction default None), MCP (`_mcp_llm.py:159` passes `graph=graph`), and library (`llm/completion.py:479`). `test_verify_completion_facades.py` + `test_completion_child_scope.py` — 44 pass.
3. Test fake now `verify_signature(cid, kind=None, repo_root=None)`; certified-child branch exercised. `test_completion_verification_workflow.py` — 10 pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `REBAR_NO_SYNC` parses via the shared truthy convention; regression test pins it. (test_config_sync_aliases 6 pass)
- [x] `graph=False` reaches `verify_completion` unchanged over MCP + CLI; test covers it. (facades+child_scope 44 pass)
- [x] The test fake matches `verify_signature(cid, kind=…, repo_root=…)`; the certified-child branch is exercised. (workflow 10 pass)
- [x] Commit carries a `rebar-ticket:` trailer. [operator-attested] Fixes landed piecemeal on origin/main under other tickets; no dedicated 79a8 commit exists, resolution confirmed by the passing regression tests above.
